title: Christmas Gnome with antlers
text: Christmas Gnome with antlers. I am Finnish and so to me, this is a tonntu.. others call them tomte (Swed) or nisse (Norway)... very Scandinavian.  They are happy little guys that like to protect your home... however, be careful to treat them with love or they can become mischievous!  This guy is tall and wider than I expected.  His antlers are wired so they are easy to set.  While he is heavier at the base - he is harder to stand as he wants to fall over.  I did finally get him to stand.  The other thing is that his beard is  cut at a diagonal - awkwardly  -  but I feel that just makes him unique.  I love him.
